profile.headline: Sr Staff Software Engineer @ SoFi | AWS Certified Solutions Architect
profile.summary:
With over sixteen years of experience as a senior software engineer, I have developed and led various projects using a wide range of technologies, from open source backend like Java, Kotlin. I have also worked with Microsoft technologies like C# and Azure, and obtained the AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate credential.

Currently, I am a key player at SoFi, where I advance technology and improve member experiences. I oversee the development and maintenance of system architectures, optimize service operations for reliability and efficiency, guide and develop engineering talent, and tackle hands-on coding for critical projects. I have also contributed to the design and implementation of the new Registry Service and the Central Notification Platform at GoDaddy, and co-authored a publication on customer engagement software for websites. My ability to adapt, collaborate, and deliver results has been very useful in different organizations and environments. I am always willing to learn and make an effort to achieve the business goals and provide value to the customers.

positions.title: Sr Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Senior Staff Software Engineer at SoFi, I am a key player in advancing technology and improving member experiences. My role involves leading architectural design and operations, mentoring engineers, and directly contributing to critical projects.

Responsibilities:

Architecture & Design: Oversee the development and maintenance of system architectures. Author and review design documents, ensuring best practices and system integration.
Service Excellence: Optimize service operations for peak performance, focusing on reliability and efficiency.
Team Mentorship: Guide and develop engineering talent, promoting skill growth and fostering a collaborative environment.
Hands-On Involvement: Tackle hands-on coding for high-impact projects and navigate technical solutions impacting millions of customers.
Project Leadership: Steer key initiatives like the Tax Document Center, Growth Platform, Member Home Experience, and Member Benefits Organization, enhancing member services and organizational growth.
Impact:
My role significantly contributes to SoFi's mission, driving customer satisfaction and business growth through technical leadership and innovative solutions.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
2021-Present: Team lead of Central Notification Platform at GoDaddy. We create a robust, extendable, and easy to plug-in solution for all teams that want to send notifications to Godaddy customers. We are going to support millions of messages monthly. 
2020-2021: Part of tiger team to work on consolidate and moving the company observability solution from AWS elastic search to Elastic Search enterprise. The second half of the year, I was part of another team to help to design and implement the new Registry Service that help monitor all services on AWS cloud.
2018-2020 :  Team lead of 4 engineers managing secret and certificate management for godaddy internal teams. We are part of CTO organization that help all internal teams which became platform organization. I am responsible for helping with new design and implement secret management service. In addition, created new encryption service, and adding all performance testing and work with Dev manager to ensure the service is highly available and scalable. As a team leader, I help to mentor junior engineers to explore their potential and improve their software development. I like helping others and so I enjoy this role from helping our team to improve the velocity in 50% of completing the user stories.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and implemented the new version Multi-IP Creator for Author to created adventures for all IP games.
Designed and implemented the new version of the player game for each IP.  
Using Unity to implement the UI, C# for scripting all middle-tier services and data layer before saving to Azure.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
March 2016 to September 2016
I am part of PAAS team that is helping to develop extend custom visual for PowerBI. 
September 2016 to 2017
I am part of Dynamics 365
